newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent mixed, pares losses, range bound.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent mixed, pares losses, range bound.

text.p: June Brent crude futures pared losses by late afternoon trading on Monday, but the short- term direction remained unchanged as players assessed news of production cutbacks in Nigeria.
June Brent was last traded down one cent at $18.26 per barrel from London's settlement on Friday. July traded one cent higher at $18.35. Volume was a slight 49 lots.

Brokers said the market was range trading, with news that Shell had shut in 95,000 barrels per day of Forcados production prompting a brief rally Friday, but without breaking the critical upside June barrier of $18.64.
Brokers said they would not take a more bullish view of the Shell news unless there were cancellations of exports to indicate a tightening of what is an amply supplied market.
"Technically, we need to fill the chart gap (June) between $18.64/$18.77 to be convinced the market has broken the down trend," one broker said.
NYMEX June crude was last traded on ACCESS at $19.95 per barrel, down four cents from New York on Friday.
